Eleventh Hour

Eleventh Hour blends lush folk & indie with soaring Welsh vocals, offering lineups from 3 to 6-piece with an optional all-female horn section.

About Eleventh Hour

Eleventh Hour is the perfect blend of folk, indie, and Welsh soul , fronted by the charismatic Andy on lead vocals and acoustic guitar. Their standard 3-piece lineup features bass and drums , and can expand to a 4-piece with saxophone and female vocals , or a full 6-piece with trumpet and trombone, delivering rich harmonies and bold brass flair. With 80+ songs in their repertoire and genres spanning folk, indie, pop, rock, reggae, soul, and alternative , they tailor every setlist to your taste—plus, they’ll happily learn your first dance or any special request. Andy’s credits include BBC Radio Wales A-List , the Billboard World Songwriting Contest , and working with Becky Hill, Ellie Goulding, Sigma, Ronan Keating , and more. Bandmates have recorded for Netflix’s The Witcher and Universal artists like Lewis Capaldi . They bring full PA, lighting , and even offer a band-member DJ to keep the party going. Expect smooth communication, full flexibility, and unforgettable live music with Eleventh Hour.
